note-taker-addons.title: Note Taker + Add-ons
note-taker-addons.description: A system for automatic processing of meeting notes (Fireflies) through Airtable. Enables comprehensive management of business conversation data, meeting analysis, integration with other tools, and AI processing with various prompts.
note-taker-addons.fullDescription:
## About the Project

The "Note Taker + Add-ons" system is an advanced solution that automates the processing of business meeting notes. It integrates the Fireflies transcription tool with the Airtable database, creating a central knowledge repository from conversations.

The main goal of the project was to eliminate manual note-taking and provide easy access to key information from every meeting. The system automatically retrieves transcriptions, analyzes them using AI models (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o), and extracts the most important conclusions, tasks, and decisions.

## How It Works

1. **Recording & Transcription**: Fireflies automatically joins meetings and creates a transcription.
2. **Synchronization**: Make (formerly Integromat) retrieves data and transfers it to Airtable.
3. **AI Analysis**: Using OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, the system analyzes conversation content against defined criteria (e.g., budget, deadlines, risks).
4. **Distribution**: Summaries are automatically sent to the appropriate people or systems (e.g., Slack, CRM).
note-taker-addons.features.1: Sentiment analysis and key topic extraction by AI
note-taker-addons.features.2: Task generation in Project Management systems
note-taker-addons.features.3: Semantic search in the knowledge base
note-taker-addons.benefits.0: Saving 5-10 hours per week on notes
note-taker-addons.benefits.2: Faster onboarding of new employees thanks to the knowledge base
lead-generator.title: Lead Generator
lead-generator.description: A system for automatic contact database generation based on Google Search, Apollo, and The Company API. Automatic lead generation for specified parameters, rapid contact base building, and automatic data verification.
lead-generator.fullDescription:
## About the Project

Lead Generator is a tool built to automate the B2B customer acquisition process. It aggregates data from multiple sources such as Google Search, Apollo, and The Company API to create a consistent and verified contact database.

The system allows you to define an Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), then automatically searches for matching companies, finds decision-makers, and verifies their contact details. This provides the sales team with ready-to-use leads, significantly increasing the effectiveness of outbound activities.

## Process

1. **Search**: Define criteria and scrape search results.
2. **Enrichment**: Retrieve detailed company and employee data from external APIs.
3. **Verification**: Validate email addresses and phone numbers.
4. **Export**: Deliver ready leads to CRM or cold mailing campaigns.
lead-generator.features.0: Data aggregation from multiple sources (Google, Apollo, LinkedIn)
lead-generator.features.2: Data enrichment with financial and technological information
lead-generator.benefits.1: 90% reduction in time spent on research
context-based-chatbot.title: Context-based Chatbot
context-based-chatbot.description: An intelligent chatbot/voicebot for website and messenger communication using AI for contextual conversations. The system understands user intent, conducts natural conversations about offerings, and can perform automated actions.
context-based-chatbot.fullDescription:
## About the Project

The Context-based Chatbot is a next-generation customer service solution. Unlike traditional chatbots based on rigid decision trees, this system uses advanced language models (LLM) and vector databases to conduct natural, contextual conversations.

The system "learns" from a provided knowledge base (documents, website, conversation history) and can answer complex questions, understanding nuances and user intent. It can also function as a voicebot, handling phone calls.

## Capabilities

- **24/7 Customer Support**: Automatic responses to questions at any time.
- **Lead Generation**: Qualifying potential customers during conversation.
- **Appointment Booking**: Integration with calendars for scheduling meetings.
- **Technical Support**: Resolving issues based on technical documentation.
context-based-chatbot.features.1: Knowledge base integration (RAG - Retrieval Augmented Generation)
integracja-systemow-phu-impex.title: Systems Integration - PHU Impex
integracja-systemow-phu-impex.descriptio: A comprehensive data synchronization system between SQL Server, Airtable, and BigQuery. Enables convenient processing of financial and accounting data in a modern interface, on-demand and automatic synchronization, and BI analytics preparation.
integracja-systemow-phu-impex.fullDescri:
## About the Project

The PHU Impex project involved creating a modern data layer integrating legacy systems (based on SQL Server) with modern cloud tools (Airtable, BigQuery). The goal was to streamline financial and accounting processes and enable advanced business analytics.

The system works bidirectionally: it pulls data from ERP systems into Airtable, where employees can easily edit and supplement it, then synchronizes changes back to the SQL database and transfers them to the BigQuery data warehouse for Power BI reporting.

## Challenges

The main challenge was ensuring data consistency with high transaction volumes and handling the client's specific business rules. Advanced error logging and data validation mechanisms were implemented.
integracja-systemow-phu-impex.features.2: User interface in Airtable for data editing
frontdesk-ai.title: Frontdesk AI
frontdesk-ai.description: A system for automatic processing and categorization of incoming email. Analyzes email messages, classifies them by category, automatically responds to common questions, and routes them to the appropriate people.
frontdesk-ai.fullDescription:
## About the Project

Frontdesk AI is an intelligent email assistant that takes over the role of first-line support. The system monitors the inbox, analyzes the content of each message, and takes appropriate actions: from categorization, through automatic responses, to creating tasks in external systems.

Thanks to AI, the system understands message context, can distinguish an invoice from a quote request or a complaint, and route the matter to the appropriate department.

## Features

- **Classification**: Automatic label and category assignment.
- **Auto-responder**: Intelligent responses to repetitive questions.
- **Data Extraction**: Extracting key information (e.g., order number, tax ID) from email content.
- **Routing**: Forwarding messages to the appropriate employees.
frontdesk-ai.features.4: Automatic ticket creation in Helpdesk systems
frontdesk-ai.benefits.0: Faster response time to customer inquiries
frontdesk-ai.benefits.1: Relieving employees from routine email handling
automatyzacje-dokumentow.title: Document Automation
automatyzacje-dokumentow.description: Comprehensive systems for document processing, generation, and workflow. Automatic generation of contracts, project documentation, integration with Autenti electronic signature. Case studies: Energocentrum (photovoltaics), Manufaktura Przygody (school trips).
automatyzacje-dokumentow.fullDescription:
## About the Project

This project encompasses a series of document workflow automation system implementations for various clients. The main goal is to accelerate the process of creating, approving, and signing documents such as contracts, proposals, reports, and protocols.

These systems integrate data from CRM or forms, generate PDF documents based on templates, and then automatically send them for electronic signature (e.g., via Autenti). After signing, documents are archived and forwarded to the relevant parties.

## Implementation Examples

- **Energocentrum**: Automatic generation of contracts for photovoltaic installations along with technical documentation.
- **Manufaktura Przygody**: Generation of contracts and trip cards for schools and tourism organizers.
automatyzacje-dokumentow.benefits.0: Contract processing time reduced from days to minutes
system-hrm.title: HRM System
system-hrm.description: A comprehensive Human Resources management system covering leave management, sick leave, and employee availability. HR process automation, request system, and automatic notifications.
system-hrm.fullDescription:
## About the Project

The HRM System is a dedicated solution built on no-code tools (Airtable, Make) for managing HR processes in small and medium-sized companies. It replaces complex spreadsheets and expensive ERP systems, offering flexibility and ease of use.

The system allows employees to submit leave requests through a simple form, automates the approval process by supervisors, and updates the team availability calendar. It also handles sick leave and other absences.

## Main Modules

- **Leave Management**: Requests, leave limits, approvals.
- **Time Tracking**: Hour and project reporting.
- **Onboarding/Offboarding**: Task lists and employee onboarding processes.
- **Employee Database**: Central HR data repository.
lead-enrichment.title: Lead Enrichment
lead-enrichment.description: An automatic system for supplementing and enriching contact data in CRM. Retrieves additional information about companies, decision-makers, and business contacts from various sources, and updates CRM data.
lead-enrichment.fullDescription:
## About the Project

The Lead Enrichment System is a tool that supports sales teams by automatically enriching data in the CRM system. Often, data entered by salespeople is incomplete -- missing phone numbers, job titles, or company revenue information. This system solves that problem.

Using AI (Perplexity, GPT-4) and specialized databases, the system automatically searches for missing information online and updates CRM records. This gives salespeople a complete picture of the customer before making the first contact.

## How It Works

The system monitors new records in the CRM. When a new lead appears, it triggers a research process: checking the company website, LinkedIn profile, and business registries. Collected data is analyzed, standardized, and saved in the appropriate CRM fields.
lead-enrichment.features.4: Lead scoring based on collected data
lead-enrichment.benefits.1: Time savings for salespeople on research
ankiety-badania-satysfakcji.title: Surveys & Satisfaction Research
ankiety-badania-satysfakcji.description: A system for automatic handling of surveys and customer/employee satisfaction research. Automatic distribution at key customer journey moments, response collection, AI-powered results analysis, and report generation.
ankiety-badania-satysfakcji.fullDescript:
## About the Project

The satisfaction research automation system (NPS, CSAT) enables continuous monitoring of customer and employee feedback without additional resources. The system integrates with survey tools (Tally) and transactional systems to send feedback requests at the perfect moment (e.g., after closing a ticket, after a purchase).

A key component is the AI analysis of open-ended responses. The system automatically categorizes feedback (positive/negative), extracts main themes (e.g., "long wait times", "friendly service"), and alerts managers in case of negative ratings.

## Applications

- **NPS Surveys**: After project completion or periodically.
- **CSAT Surveys**: After customer service contact.
- **Product Feedback**: Collecting opinions on new features.
- **Employee Surveys**: Team sentiment research.
ankiety-badania-satysfakcji.benefits.0: Rapid identification of problems and risks
ankiety-badania-satysfakcji.benefits.3: Ability to quickly respond to negative feedback
